summary: Avolta Renewable Holdings, LLC is the existing active U.S. RNG platform and a current February 2022 JV between ECP and Avolta, LLC. The record should use Avolta Development as the operating website and Charleston, West Virginia as headquarters while leaving the exact ECP fund, vehicle, stake and close day undisclosed. Avolta Energy is an unrelated Costa Rican namesake, Nacelle is a separate ECP investment and individual projects remain subordinate.
